Why this title: Energy is explicit, but board space becomes a second progression constraint around mature early/midgame

What NOT to copy: Do not create board pressure before the core grammar is understood

Why this title: Lv15 2x/4x Super Boost trades more energy for higher-level outputs and fewer merge steps
What to learn: Give players a transparent speed-vs-efficiency control instead of only selling speedups
What NOT to copy: Do not let acceleration silently destroy order efficiency

Why this title: Six non-expiring resident quests use dedicated generators and unique chains, competing with regular orders for energy/space
What to learn: Use optional permanent side goals as long-horizon sinks without hard expiry pressure
What NOT to copy: Do not let side chains permanently choke the core board

Why this title: US store visibly combines Gems, Energy, Event Packs, themed bundles, Super Pass, Loot Boxes and Advertising
What to learn: Layer monetization around core scarcity, event participation and pass value
What NOT to copy: Do not infer personalized segmentation or copy full catalog before payer data
